featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Badgeri
featured_reviews.review_text:
Date: 21st June 2026

Had a takeaway order of Garlic Pepper Chicken & Threaded Chicken.
It tasted good, packaging for takeaway was properly done.
Staff are friendly and attentive.
For takeaway, please call and order at least 30 mins before — that’s sufficient.
Regarding parking: possible for 2-wheelers, but for cars it’s on availability since it’s street parking.
Overall I loved it, and will try more from the menu in future.

featured_reviews.name: Bhargav Rai
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a fantastic experience at In. Mandarin Asian Kitchen in Kandivali East! The food was absolutely delicious—packed with authentic flavors and great portions. What really stood out, alongside the amazing food, was the excellent service; the staff was welcoming, polite, and very attentive. It’s a cozy gem in Thakur Complex. I highly recommend it to everyone—definitely a must-visit!

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited in.menderian recently and absolutely loved the experience!
We ordered Ramen and Pan-Fried Noodles, and both dishes were spot on.
The Ramen was rich, flavorful, and comforting — the broth had a nice depth with fresh veggies and soft tofu that blended perfectly. It had that warm, satisfying feel you expect from a good bowl of ramen.
The Pan-Fried Noodles were equally impressive — crispy noodles topped with a delicious, slightly spicy gravy loaded with veggies. Great texture contrast and full of flavor.

featured_reviews.name: Lewa Pereira
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had an amazing experience at Mandarin Asian Kitchen. Their Sri Lankan Sambal Dimsum was delicious, it was the perfect blend of soothing curry with a slight kick to it. We tried the Burmese Khowsuey and Malaysian flat noodles with were extremely delicious and had an authentic taste.

We tried their Panko fried Prawns Futomaki roll, squid butter garlic, and Aflatoon with ice cream which were really flavoursome!!

The service was warm, attentive, and really friendly. We appreciated the care and attention of the staff as well as the owner.
Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic and flavourful Asian cuisine in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Tina Goradia
featured_reviews.review_text:
In Mandarin Asian Restaurant delivers a consistently outstanding dining experience. The food is fresh, flavorful, and clearly prepared with attention to detail. From perfectly balanced sauces to well-cooked proteins and vibrant vegetables, every dish feels thoughtfully executed and authentic. Portion sizes are generous without being excessive, and the menu offers a great mix of classic favorites and standout specialties.

The ambiance is clean, comfortable, and welcoming, making it a solid choice for both casual meals and special occasions. Service is attentive, efficient, and genuinely warm, which elevates the overall experience. In Mandarin Asian Restaurant sets a high bar for quality, taste, and hospitality. Easily a go-to spot for excellent Asian cuisine and absolutely worth repeat visits.

Fresh, beautifully crafted, and packed with clean, bold flavors. The sushi is perfectly balanced, from the silky fish to the seasoned rice, and every bite tastes intentional. Simple, elegant, and genuinely delicious.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ordered a takeaway from New Kwanz and had a great experience. We tried the Chilli Garlic Potatoes, Pan Tossed Thin Chicken Slices, and Veg Hakka Noodles, and all three dishes were excellent.

The chilli garlic potatoes were perfectly balanced with spice and flavor, the chicken was tender and well-seasoned, and the veg Hakka noodles were fresh, well-tossed, and very satisfying.

Everything was packed well and arrived in good condition. Definitely recommended for anyone looking for tasty Indo-Chinese takeaway.

featured_reviews.name: Ganesh Badgeri
featured_reviews.review_text: I ordered from New Kwanz and it was great! The veg garlic pepper soup and Kung Pao veg gravy were delicious. The quantity was enough for 3 people. The food was tasty and well packed. No leakage issues, packaging was good. Takeaway service was also good. I'll order again and try other dishes. Overall, I'm happy with the food and service. New Kwanz is a good option for Chinese food. I'll definitely recommend it!

featured_reviews.name: Shaikh Shahbaz
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a house party with friends and ordered food from New Kwanz, and it was a perfect choice. Every dish was fresh, hot, and full of flavor. The Burnt Garlic Combo was the highlight, with a strong aroma and amazing taste. Great food, good quantity, and everyone enjoyed it. Highly recommended for parties and get-togethers!!!

featured_reviews.name: Vinayak Moorthy
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Golden Dragon Chinese Point is a haven for anyone craving authentic and flavorful Chinese cuisine! From the first bite, every dish we tried was bursting with mouth-watering goodness. The Chicken Butter Garlic was simply sublime—tender, juicy chicken bathed in a rich, buttery garlic sauce that was aromatic and indulgent. Each bite was a perfect harmony of flavors that left us wanting more.

The Bangkok Crispy Chicken was a delightful contrast—crispy, perfectly seasoned, and coated in a tangy, slightly spicy glaze that danced on our taste buds. It had the perfect crunch on the outside, while staying juicy and flavorful on the inside. This dish is a must-try for anyone who loves the bold, vibrant flavors of Asian cuisine.

To top it off, the Chicken Lemon Coriander Soup was a refreshing burst of warmth and zest, with the citrusy notes of lemon beautifully balancing the earthy coriander and tender pieces of chicken. It was comforting, light, and yet packed with flavor—a perfect start to the meal.

Golden Dragon Chinese Point exceeded all expectations with its incredible variety and taste. Every dish was prepared to perfection, leaving us already planning our next visit. Highly recommended for anyone seeking an unforgettable Chinese dining experience!

We had first ordered naan and chicken lollipop both of which were not available. Then we had ordered the surmai and promfret thali both of which were tasteless and bland. Even the rasaa was solid with a lot of kata in it.

featured_reviews.name: Arti Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: In short - overall food was good. Need the place to be more clean and fragrant. It stinked while going upstairs. The bombils were too much coated with semolina, which overpowered the taste of bombil. Joy - the server was polite and helpful.

featured_reviews.name: Rahul Kuril
featured_reviews.review_text:
We have ordered Prawns Thali and Mutton thali

The quality of food was very bad.

Javla had weird smell and taste, prawns and mutton was not fresh
Vade had so much of oil, rice quality was very poor
Butter naan had so much of salt

After complaining about the food, the staff shown a good gesture and offered us complimentary Dessert (Gulab Jamun) that was pathetic too

Though they gave us the 10% discount on the bill, but the money was not worth it

Best thing we had in overall menu was Rice Bhakri and Onions

featured_reviews.name: Ashwajeet Shetty (The Indian Backpacker)
featured_reviews.review_text: Wanted to eat Seafood and this had good rating so went. But very disappointed with the variety and quantity in Thali. The waiter quoted 600 for Surmai Thali and then bill sent was 650 for the Surmai Thali. Reason given was like the waiter did not know the price. Also served just 1 Bhakri initially after asking they gave one more. Overall thali was not that great, curry was very spicy. The place was totally empty not a single table. Looks like paid review place.

featured_reviews.name: SUHAS MANGUTKAR
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful dining experience! The food was delicious and the atmosphere was great. A special thanks to Mr. Joe for his outstanding service—he was polite, attentive, and made sure we were comfortable throughout. His professionalism truly made our visit memorable. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Sharan Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: A good dine in experience. Joy steward was excellent in behaviour and experienced as well. The food quality was also top notch. Fish was not upto the mark tho but other mutton and fish items were excellent.

name: Chinese Wala - Online Chinese Food Delivery
description:
🍜
Chinese Wala in Kandivali East is a delivery-focused Chinese restaurant offering a range of Hong Kong-style fast food dishes. The menu features an assortment of Chinese noodles and rice dishes, as well as chicken specialties like chicken lollipop. As a critic, I found the food to be decent, though not exceptional. However, the restaurant's fast and reliable delivery service is a definite plus.
🚚 Fast and reliable delivery service
🍚 Good variety of Chinese rice and noodle dishes
🍗 Tasty chicken specialties like chicken lollipop
In summary, Chinese Wala is a good option for those looking for a quick and reliable Chinese delivery restaurant in Kandivali East.
